items.title: Official CJP 'illegally kidnapped' claim post is gone from @cockroachjantaparty — deleted within ~1 hour of posting
items.summary: The official @cockroachjantaparty post (posted ~10:43 AM PDT / ~11:13 PM IST, Oct 13) claiming Ranka, Das and Shinde were 'illegally kidnapped' for 14+ hours and calling Delhi Police 'puppets of the government' is no longer on the handle. It was live and alerted at ~10:49 AM PDT (~19K likes within minutes); by ~11:52 AM PDT a direct post lookup returns 'Could not load post on any platform' and a sweep of 928 posts on the account finds no trace of it. Whether CJP pulled it or Instagram removed it is unclear — Instagram is currently restricting protest-related accounts at scale (MediaNama: 200+ Sahyog takedown orders ahead of Oct 10; IFF says ~20 accounts taken down/restricted). No re-post or explanation from the handle yet. Watch for a repost or official explanation.
items.source_name: Instagram (official handle, verified via instagram-cli direct lookup)
